name: claim_subdomain
description:
Claim Subdomain (Post-Auction)

Used after winning a subdomain auction to **claim ownership** of the
minted Subdomain Item (NFT) to the user's wallet.

Parameters:
- **subdomain_item_address**: Address of the subdomain NFT to claim.
- **query_id**: Optional query identifier for async tracking.

Returns:
- **TransactionResponse** containing a single **transfer message**
  that moves the subdomain NFT to the user's wallet.

subdomain_item_address.description: Address of the Subdomain Item contract
subdomain_item_address.title: Subdomain Item Address

name: deploy_proxy_zone
description:
Deploy Proxy Zone (curated)

Minimal-input version of **Deploy Bundle**: deploys a Subdomain Collection,
binds it as the DNS item's `next_resolver`, and mints a Proxy Item for the
given DNS name into the platform's Wrapper Collection - in one bundle.

All platform-owned parameters (owner/second owner/royalty split/pricing,
and the target Wrapper Collection address) are filled in server-side from
platform config, matching what the app itself always sends. Only the
domain and the caller's own wallet need to be supplied.

Parameters:
- **dns_item_address**: TON DNS item to be linked via `next_resolver`.
- **dns_item_name**: TON DNS label (e.g., `"minter"` for `minter.ton`).
- **user_wallet_address**: Address of the caller's TON wallet - receives
  the minted Proxy Item and the collection's partner-share revenue.
- **tld**: Top-level domain (default `"ton"`).
- **query_id**: Optional query identifier.

Returns:
- **TransactionResponse** with the same 3-message bundle as Deploy Bundle.

dns_item_address.description: Address of the TON DNS item contract
dns_item_address.title: Dns Item Address

user_wallet_address.description: Address of the user TON wallet
user_wallet_address.title: User Wallet Address

name: deploy_sbt_zone
description:
Deploy SBT Zone (curated)

Minimal-input version of **Deploy SBT Subdomain Collection and Set DNS
Next Resolver**: deploys a soulbound SBT-mode Subdomain Collection for
the given domain and binds it as the DNS item's `next_resolver`, in one
bundle.

Platform-owned owner/second-owner values are filled in server-side from
platform config. Only the domain and the caller's own wallet
(partner-share recipient) need to be supplied.

Parameters:
- **dns_item_address**: TON DNS item to be linked via `next_resolver`.
- **tld**: Top-level domain (default `"ton"`).
- **domain**: Domain name (e.g., `"minter"`).
- **user_wallet_address**: Address of the caller's TON wallet - receives
  the collection's partner-share revenue.
- **query_id**: Optional query identifier.

Returns:
- **TransactionResponse** with 2 messages: deploy+fund SBT collection,
  set DNS next_resolver.

dns_item_address.description: Address of the TON DNS item contract
dns_item_address.title: Dns Item Address

user_wallet_address.description: Address of the user TON wallet
user_wallet_address.title: User Wallet Address

name: get_inactive_subdomain_collection_image
description:

name: mint_sbt_subdomain
description:
Mint SBT Subdomain

Mints a soulbound subdomain item under an **SBT-mode Subdomain
Collection** at the fixed flat price - same on-chain comment message the
app itself sends (`op=0` + subdomain name as plain-text comment).

Parameters:
- **collection_address**: Address of the SBT-mode Subdomain Collection.
- **subdomain_name**: Subdomain label to mint.

Returns:
- **TransactionResponse** with a single comment message (flat 0.5 TON).

collection_address.description: Address of the SBT-mode Subdomain Collection contract
collection_address.title: Collection Address

name: start_auction
description:
Start Subdomain Auction

Mints a subdomain item under a **Proxy-mode Subdomain Collection**,
entering its 24h auction phase - same on-chain comment message the app
itself sends (`op=0` + subdomain name as plain-text comment).

Parameters:
- **collection_address**: Address of the Proxy-mode Subdomain Collection.
- **subdomain_name**: Subdomain label to start the auction for.

Returns:
- **TransactionResponse** with a single comment message, priced by
  subdomain length using the platform's standard price table.

collection_address.description: Address of the Proxy-mode Subdomain Collection contract
collection_address.title: Collection Address

subdomain_name.description: Subdomain label to start an auction for.
subdomain_name.title: Subdomain Name
